entityDescription:
SpaceGuardian is a subscription-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform that provides automatic satellite collision prevention and maneuver optimization for commercial satellite operators. By continuously monitoring satellite trajectories and leveraging predictive algorithms, SpaceGuardian proactively identifies potential collisions and autonomously calculates, simulates, and executes optimal avoidance maneuvers.
Unlike traditional tools that rely on manual, error-prone, and fuel-intensive post-collision detection processes, SpaceGuardian delivers a fully automated, intelligent, and fuel-efficient response system. The platform considers long-term satellite health by optimizing for fuel usage, future collision risk, and mission efficiency.
It supports advanced scenarios such as:
- Maneuverable vs. Non-Maneuverable satellite encounters,
- Maneuverable vs. Maneuverable cases using an integrated bidding system where the lower bidder performs the maneuver,
- Future collision prediction with early, minor adjustments to prevent major course corrections later.

entityDescription:
The birth of TestIT in 2016 was driven by the increasing global trend towards digitization and the simultaneous underestimation of the vital role of testing. During this period, fierce competition in the corporate world underscored the fact that efficiency and providing top-notch service to customers were the keys to success. This, in turn, elevated the importance of the quality and sustainability of IT developments.
TestIT emerged in response to the challenge of providing expert testing resources for IT projects where the necessary technology or expertise was lacking. From the outset, our goal was to create lasting value for our clients through innovative solutions.
Thanks to a string of successful projects, we quickly expanded our range of software quality assurance tasks to encompass areas like business analysis, process automation, and service management. This allowed us to offer even more comprehensive services to our valued partners.

However, at TestIT, we don't just focus on work. We also place great importance on unity and community. Our internal training system enables the sharing of knowledge and the development of individual strengths. Additionally, we organize numerous community events where relaxation and good spirits take center stage.
As a young and dynamic team, we've now surpassed a staff of 90, and our presence extends not only to Budapest but also to Pécs, where we've opened an office, and we've even established a German subsidiary in Munich.
Our goal is to effectively support ambitious large enterprises in the realm of IT development. At TestIT, we're deeply committed to the principles of quality, innovation, and the success of our clients.

entityDescription:
FAST Aerospace is developing a launcher with a Launch as a Service (LaaS) business model. In the meantime, it is also capitalizing on intermediary technological products. Today, it focuses on ramjet propulsion systems, building proprietary know-how and corporate value. Through partnerships and a “make-to-order” model, private or public customers can request custom-built ramjet engines tailored to their mission profiles and performance specifications.
After the ramjet, FAST aims at commercializing StratoDart, a high-speed flight test platform designed for supersonic and hypersonic applications. This technological milestone can be leveraged thanks to a Test as a Service (TaaS) model, in which customers can lease onboard payload space to flight-test advanced materials, software, or components at high Mach numbers in relevant atmospheric conditions.
Finally, once HyperDart reaches the market, FAST enter the space access market. With LaaS, customers send their satellites to one of FAST’s integration hubs, where the payload is prepared and integrated in a cleanroom according to mission-specific requirements. The payload faring is then mounted on HyperDart’s second stage, ready for takeoff and orbit insertion.

description: Space2Earth is a satellite intelligence startup that transforms satellite and environmental data into actionable insights for smarter, safer, and more sustainable infrastructure management. The company’s modular approach allows clients to access specific analytical services — such as vegetation monitoring, surface anomaly detection, and ESG impact reporting — directly through the cloud, ensuring scalability and ease of integration. To do this, we use satellite data, process it, make it simple and available via a collaboration platform for you to share with colleagues and decision makers. We are committed to using incontrovertible data that - if wished - can be certified by our blockchain solution. Thus we enable unbiased environmental impact assessments. We want to work with you and create a sustainable future using our experience and technologies.
The vision of space2earth is to collect satellite data, process it, produce analysis and make it available to our customers. In this way we provide the evidence to reduce environmental impacts and also increase the value of how you use your land. We select useful data using satellites and provide support services to improve our environment. With our 'as a Service' business model, our clients pay only the modules tailored to their needs at limited costs and without any heavy up-front investments.

Weldmetrix GmbH is an Austrian high-tech SME founded in 2021, specializing in intelligent process monitoring solutions for laser-based manufacturing. The company develops modular hardware and software systems for in-situ quality assurance, including high-speed optical sensors (WLDR series) and the PROMOS software platform for real-time data acquisition, analysis, and control.
Weldmetrix solutions are used in advanced industrial applications such as laser welding, cladding, and additive manufacturing — supporting customers in automotive, aerospace, and e-mobility sectors. The company’s technology enables digital twins, process traceability, and AI-driven defect detection, contributing to higher process reliability and reduced material waste.
Headquartered in Vienna, Weldmetrix operates within a strong R&D ecosystem, collaborating with leading research institutes such as TU Wien, SKZ, and the Center for Digital Production. Its multidisciplinary team combines expertise in optics, electronics, software engineering, and applied physics, focusing on scalable and integrable solutions for Industry 4.0 and future space-related manufacturing applications.

entityDescription:
Portolan Association, established in 2021 and based in Geneva, Switzerland, is a non-profit organization focused on the monitoring of water resources and climate to support integrated water resources management. Its core activities include hydrometeorological monitoring, hydraulic analysis, and the improvement of water data availability for end-users and decision-makers. Portolan works across diverse geographic contexts, with a particular emphasis on data-driven approaches to support sustainable water governance and climate adaptation strategies.
Portolan collaborates closely with leading academic institutions such as the Technical University of Munich (TUM), University of Fribourg, Brunel University, University of Twente, Grenoble University, Delft Technical University, and the Central Asian Institute for Applied Geosciences. These partnerships have enabled Portolan to carry out extensive fieldwork and applied research, contributing to both academic knowledge and practical applications in water and environmental management.
Portolan has also contributed to the preparation of ecosystem research and restoration, particularly in relation to the monitoring of Nature-Based Solutions (NbS) and their performance under varying hydrological conditions. Our expertise spans mountainous regions, wetlands, and river basins.
The association’s strength lies in its interdisciplinary approach, combining hydrological and climate monitoring (including soil moist, snow and groundwater where relevant) with the analysis of impacts of hydraulic structures on lakes and rivers. This enables us to support adaptive water management practices that are responsive to both environmental variability and infrastructure dynamics.

entityDescription:
LifeWatch ERIC is the European e-Science Infrastructure for Biodiversity and Ecosystem Research, set up as a European Research Infrastructure Consortium (ERIC) under EU law in 2017. Headquartered in Seville, Spain, it brings together contributions from several member countries to provide the scientific community with advanced digital tools and services. Its mission is to integrate data, models, and research capacities across Europe to help address pressing environmental challenges such as climate change, habitat loss, invasive species, and the sustainable management of natural resources. By offering interoperable and open access to data and services, LifeWatch ERIC plays a central role in strengthening the European Research Area.
Through its virtual research environments, high-performance computing resources, and advanced data integration services, LifeWatch ERIC enables scientists and policymakers to better understand, monitor, and protect biodiversity and ecosystems. It supports cutting-edge research, fosters innovation in environmental management, and builds capacity through training and collaboration, ultimately acting as a bridge between science, governance, and society.

BioActiveMetals was the winner of the startup competition Switch2Product (S2P) edition 2021 organized by Politecnico of Milan. The company is very young, founded at the beginning of 2024. The two managing directors are the owners and founders. They have a long and consolidated industrial experience in advanced metallurgy of functional alloys, in particular Nitinol and NiTi-based shape memory alloys, from VIM melting to final processing through an ad-hoc engineering and characterization of SMA components by hot and cold working, like rolling and drawing, final annealing (shape setting) and training. Expertise in designing of new alloys, driven by specific medical and industrial requirements, is demonstrated by more than 20 issued patents over their carriers.

entityDescription: Delphea is a technology company specialized in the development of the European ECORCE TCAD tool, an advanced simulation software designed to model and predict the impact of radiation on semiconductor devices, including Total Ionizing Dose (TID), Total Non-Ionizing Dose (TNID), and Single Event Effects (SEE). Combining a powerful dynamic mesh generator with high-accuracy algorithms, ECORCE enables efficient multidimensional simulations in a single run, supporting industries where reliability under harsh environments is critical, such as aerospace, space exploration, nuclear energy, medical technology, and automotive electronics. Founded in 2019 with roots at the University of Montpellier, Delphea also provides consulting, case studies, and training, bridging simulation with experimental data to help organizations analyze radiation sensitivity, interpret test results, qualify new devices, and improve overall robustness in extreme conditions.
